I replied to Marcus in his DM: send Thursday's Tamsin Cold Chain truck to **Door 28**. He told me that in this same DM on Oct 14, and it applies to his Tamarack pickups. I asked him to let me know if it has changed so I can update my note.

I only used Marcus's own note. The other members' dock notes for Tamsin (Ilse's Gate 20, Dana's Bay 47) are private to their DMs, so I left them out.
